data.one_liner: A material design single and range slider widget with vertical and horizontal support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable slider and range slider widget supporting horizontal and vertical axes, RTL layouts, tooltips, trackbars, step configurations, and fixed values.
use_when: You need a range slider or single slider with advanced customization options.
You require vertical sliders or right-to-left layout support.
You need step restrictions, ignore steps, or fixed value selections.
avoid_when: You only need the standard Material design Slider or RangeSlider widgets built into Flutter.
strengths: Highly customizable handlers, tooltips, and trackbars.
Supports both horizontal and vertical axes as well as RTL.
Advanced range features like step customization, minimum/maximum distance, and fixed values.
weaknesses: Relies on external pub package for features that are increasingly covered by Flutter's built-in Material sliders.
